checks.detail: Latest lawful main, tree, material programme pointers and open authority blockers were inspected before design freeze.
Candidate design/plan commit changes documentation only; no IROF implementation package exists on the candidate.
Design defines IROF as execution/evidence infrastructure and explicitly denies market/scientific/exposure authority.
SRFD orchestration/scheduler/cache/capacity, SFC replay, C2E assurance, OccurrenceContext and Research Operations primitives are assigned reuse/conformance roles rather than duplicated.
Current SRFD June authorization and current C2E real-replay denial are represented as separate owner authorities; IROF may not union them.
OccurrenceContext remains an orthogonal context branch and current REPRESENTATION_INPUT rejection is preserved.
Future C2P, C2.5, C3, MCARB, OPT-C and OPT-D are registered through StageSpec/dependencies rather than hard-coded scheduler semantics.
Capacity handling preserves population, methods, grids, thresholds and denominators and admits CAPACITY_EXCEEDED without scientific mutation.
Existing canonical identity, artifact catalogue, QA, storage and read model are integration targets; no parallel evidence store is proposed.
IROF-G0 is the only planned operator-required IROF engineering entry gate; reserved scientific/real-data actions remain owned externally.

warnings: C2E real-source replay remains denied/deferred; a full-descriptive real June run is not currently lawful.
SRFD has one exact bounded June token unconsumed; IROF-G0 does not request or consume it.
PR #433 remains relevant capacity evidence and PR #418 remains a historical draft fixture source; neither is to be merged into IROF.
Telemetry availability is platform-dependent and must use explicit UNAVAILABLE/measurement-class semantics.
